div.div:
Client connects via LB, receives
OHTTP public key + ITA token from a CVM (e.g. CVM 1). Verifies token with ITA,
confirms key is bound to attested TEE.

div.div:
Client encrypts with CVM 1 key, LB routes to any CVM (e.g., CVM 3).
CVM 3 holds CVM 1 private key from Phase 3, decrypts and serves via vLLM.
The response is encrypted using the OHTTP channel and sent back.
